value.__expression:
'Castilla is a coastal municipality in the province of Sorsogon, in the Bicol Region of the Philippines. ' +
  'This portal brings together public information about the municipality, its local government leadership, ' +
  'and the offices that serve residents, businesses, and visitors.'

'Before 1827, the settlement that became Castilla was a barrio of Bulabog (in what is now Sorsogon City), ' +
  'formed from the nearby settlements of Inarihan, Capuy, Macalaya, and Cumadcad. Spanish Dominican friars had ' +
  'founded the original town along the western coast of Sorsogon Bay, and in 1827 it was formalized as an ' +
  'independent town under the old Provincia de Albay. Don Eugenio Santos Martinez, a wealthy Spanish landowner ' +
  'native to Castilla, Spain, recommended both relocating the seat of government and renaming the town in honor ' +
  'of his hometown — itself the birthplace of Queen Isabella I of Castile (r. 1451–1504). Castilla received its ' +
  'own parish in 1876, with Father Teodosio Homillano as its first priest; the church’s inauguration fell on the ' +
  'Feast of Saint John the Baptist, June 24, still celebrated locally today. When Sorsogon was separated into its ' +
  'own province in 1894, Castilla was annexed as one of its constituent towns.'

municipality.data.ts.comment: Sourced 2026-08-23 from the official LGU Castilla history page (castillasorsogon.gov.ph/history-of-castilla) via a cross-referencing community mirror (marvelos.wixsite.com/castillasorsogon/history), since the official domain blocks automated fetching — facts corroborated against independent web-search results before being written here.

Left as a placeholder rather than publishing an incomplete quote.

value.__expression:
'To pursue a holistic development of Castilla in an ecologically-sound environment through the convergent ' +
  'efforts in the provision of quality basic services and equitable distribution of resources and opportunities.'

municipality.data.ts.comment: Sourced 2026-08-23 from the official LGU Castilla Vision and Mission page (castillasorsogon.gov.ph/vision-and-mission), via search-result extraction since the page itself blocks automated fetching. Unlike the Vision statement, this sentence was returned complete (no truncation marker).

value.__expression:
'The official seal of Castilla — "Sagisag ng Bayan ng Castilla" — features a mountain range, a coconut palm, ' +
  'farm produce, and a leaping dolphin over a coastline, framed by a golden rope border, with the municipality’s ' +
  'name and "Sorsogon" inscribed along the rim. A full official description of the seal’s symbolism is pending ' +
  'confirmation from LGU Castilla.'

municipality.data.ts.comment: Description below is a plain visual transcription of the elements actually present in the official seal artwork used on this portal — it does not assert heraldic or symbolic meaning, which is left to the official LGU description once available.

fields.name: Office of the Municipal Mayor
fields.shortDescription: Leads the executive administration of the municipality and oversees all local government operations.
fields.aboutText: The Office of the Municipal Mayor exercises general supervision over all municipal offices, implements local policies and ordinances, and represents the municipality in official and ceremonial functions.
services: Executive supervision of municipal departments and offices
Enforcement of laws, ordinances, and executive issuances
Representation of the municipality in official matters

fields.name: Office of the Municipal Vice Mayor
fields.shortDescription: Presides over the Sangguniang Bayan and assumes executive duties in the Mayor’s absence.
fields.aboutText: The Office of the Municipal Vice Mayor presides over sessions of the Sangguniang Bayan, the municipality’s legislative body, and performs executive functions as provided under the Local Government Code.
services: Presiding officer of the Sangguniang Bayan
Legislative session scheduling and records oversight
Assumption of mayoral duties when required by law

fields.name: Sangguniang Bayan
fields.shortDescription: The municipality’s legislative council, responsible for enacting local ordinances and resolutions.
fields.aboutText: The Sangguniang Bayan is the legislative body of the municipality. It enacts ordinances, approves resolutions, and appropriates funds for the general welfare of Castilla in accordance with the Local Government Code.
services: Enactment of municipal ordinances and resolutions
Approval of the annual municipal budget

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23: identified in Sorsogon State University institutional material.

fields.name: Municipal Administrator
fields.shortDescription: Coordinates the day-to-day management of municipal departments on behalf of the Mayor.
fields.aboutText: The Office of the Municipal Administrator assists the Mayor in coordinating the activities of all municipal departments, ensuring efficient delivery of services and implementation of programs.

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23: LGU Citizen's Charter, corroborated by a PSA Sorsogon publication (2024 CBMS presentation, August 2025).
fieldComments.contact: Direct phone/email/room not found — the Mayor's Office line should not be presented as the Administrator's direct contact. Hours are the Administrator's own published schedule (Citizen's Charter).

fields.name: Municipal Treasurer's Office
fields.shortDescription: Manages collection, custody, and disbursement of municipal funds.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Treasurer’s Office is responsible for the collection of local taxes, fees, and charges, and for the custody and proper disbursement of municipal funds.
services: Collection of real property and business taxes
Issuance of official receipts and tax clearances

contact.__expression: placeholderContact('Castilla Municipal Hall, 1st Floor, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon')

fieldComments.head: The 2023 Citizen's Charter named a Treasurer, but Castilla subsequently advertised this post (Municipal Government Department Head I – Municipal Treasurer) as vacant in late 2025 — publishing that name now risks naming someone no longer in the role, so the head stays unconfirmed. The office's own floor is unaffected by who staffs it, so that alone is updated.

fields.name: Municipal Assessor's Office
fields.shortDescription: Handles the appraisal and assessment of real properties for taxation purposes.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Assessor’s Office appraises and assesses real properties within Castilla, maintains property records, and issues certifications used for taxation and land transactions.

contact.location: Castilla Municipal Hall, 1st Floor, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23 from the LGU Citizen's Charter.

fields.name: Municipal Accounting Office
fields.shortDescription: Maintains municipal financial records and processes payment vouchers.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Accounting Office maintains the books of accounts of the municipality, processes disbursement vouchers, and prepares financial statements and reports.
services: Processing of disbursement vouchers and payrolls
Maintenance of municipal books of accounts

contact.location: Castilla Municipal Hall, 2nd Floor, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23 from the LGU Citizen's Charter.

fields.name: Municipal Budget Office
fields.shortDescription: Prepares and administers the annual municipal budget.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Budget Office prepares the annual and supplemental budgets of the municipality and monitors the utilization of appropriated funds across departments.
services: Preparation of the annual municipal budget

contact.location: Castilla Municipal Hall, 2nd Floor, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23 from the LGU Citizen's Charter.

fields.name: Municipal Planning and Development Office
fields.shortDescription: Formulates the municipality’s development plans, programs, and investment priorities.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Planning and Development Office formulates integrated development plans, monitors program implementation, and coordinates local development projects for Castilla.
services: Formulation of the Comprehensive Development Plan

contact.location: Castilla Municipal Hall, 2nd Floor, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23: LGU Citizen's Charter, corroborated by a PSA Sorsogon publication (2025 CBMS presentation).

fields.name: Municipal Engineering Office
fields.shortDescription: Oversees public infrastructure planning, construction, and maintenance.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Engineering Office plans, designs, and supervises the construction and maintenance of municipal infrastructure such as roads, buildings, and public facilities.

contact.location: Castilla Municipal Hall, 2nd Floor, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23 from the LGU Citizen's Charter. The email it lists is a personal address belonging to someone other than this office's named head, which is why it is now withheld below — see the note on the contact record. The observation was made when this was first written; the owner ruled on it 2026-08-30.

fields.name: Municipal Civil Registrar
fields.shortDescription: Handles civil registration records including birth, marriage, and death certificates.
fields.aboutText: The Office of the Municipal Civil Registrar registers vital events — births, marriages, and deaths — occurring within Castilla, and issues certified civil registry documents.
services: Registration of births, marriages, and deaths
Issuance of certified civil registry documents
Processing of legal corrections and annotations

contact.location: Castilla Municipal Hall, 1st Floor, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23 from the LGU Citizen's Charter.

fields.name: Municipal Health Office
fields.shortDescription: Delivers primary healthcare services and public health programs to residents.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Health Office provides primary healthcare, maternal and child health services, disease prevention programs, and sanitation oversight for the municipality.

fields.name: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office
fields.shortDescription: Administers social welfare programs for vulnerable and disadvantaged residents.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office implements assistance programs for children, senior citizens, persons with disabilities, and families in crisis, and coordinates with national social welfare agencies.

head.name: Roland A. Cortezano, RSW
head.position: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Officer

services: Assistance programs for indigent and vulnerable residents

contact.location: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23 from the LGU Citizen's Charter.
fieldComments.contact: Exact floor/room within the office building wasn't specified in the source, only the office itself — location left at that level.

fields.name: Municipal Agriculture Office
fields.shortDescription: Supports local farmers and fisherfolk through extension services and programs.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Agriculture Office provides technical assistance, extension services, and program support to farmers and fisherfolk to improve agricultural productivity in Castilla.
services: Distribution of program inputs and assistance

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23 from an official LGU Castilla document (Agricultures.pdf).

fields.name: Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office
fields.shortDescription: Oversees environmental protection, waste management, and natural resource programs.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office implements environmental protection measures, solid waste management, and natural resource conservation programs within the municipality.

head.name: Ricardo L. Averilla
head.position: Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Officer

services: Coastal and natural resource protection initiatives

contact.location: Castilla Municipal Hall, 2nd Floor, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon

fields.name: Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office
fields.shortDescription: Coordinates disaster preparedness, response, and risk reduction efforts.
fields.aboutText: The Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office leads preparedness planning, early warning coordination, and emergency response operations to protect residents from natural and human-induced hazards.

contact.hours: Administrative: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM · Emergency response: 24/7

fieldComments.head: Name sourced 2026-08-23, independently corroborated: first surfaced as a lower-confidence inference from the office email's username, then confirmed via LGU-published MDRRMO material naming him directly.
fieldComments.contact: Exact floor within the Municipal Building wasn't specified in any source found, only the building itself. Hours distinguish ordinary administrative business from the office's actual emergency-response function, which runs continuously.

fields.name: Business Permits and Licensing Office
fields.shortDescription: Processes business permit applications, renewals, and licensing requirements.
fields.aboutText: The Business Permits and Licensing Office processes the issuance and renewal of business permits, coordinates with regulatory offices for evaluation, and maintains the municipal business registry.

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23: named on an official Castilla business-permit application form and the LGU Citizen's Charter (as Administrative Assistant II handling BPLO review/validation).

fields.name: Human Resource Management Office
fields.shortDescription: Manages municipal personnel administration, recruitment, and employee welfare.
fields.aboutText: The Human Resource Management Office administers recruitment, employee records, benefits, and personnel development programs for municipal government employees.

contact.location: Castilla Municipal Hall, 3rd Floor, Cumadcad, Castilla, Sorsogon

fieldComments.head: Sourced 2026-08-23: LGU Citizen's Charter, corroborated by recent Civil Service recruitment postings still directing applicants to her.

fields.name: General Services Office
fields.shortDescription: Manages municipal property, procurement support, and general facilities upkeep.
fields.aboutText: The General Services Office manages municipal government property and equipment, supports procurement processes, and maintains municipal facilities and vehicles.

fields.name: FSEC for Building Permit (BFP)
fields.description: The Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC) is issued by the Bureau of Fire Protection before a Building Permit is granted, confirming that building plans meet fire safety requirements under the Fire Code of the Philippines.
requirements: Three (3) complete sets of proposed plans covering: Architectural, Civil/Structural, Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, Electronics, Sanitary, and Fire Protection documents
Fire Safety Compliance Report (FSCR), one (1) set, if necessary
Cost estimate of the building, including labor cost, signed and sealed by the designer/contractor and duly notarized
Fire Safety Clearance for Welding, Cutting, and other Hot Work Operations, if required
fields.validity: Valid for the specific project/plans evaluated; not a recurring renewal item
fields.processNote: Normally required before the Building Permit itself is approved.

fields.name: FSIC for Occupancy Permit (BFP)
fields.description: The Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) is issued by the Bureau of Fire Protection after construction, confirming that the completed building matches its approved fire safety plans (FSEC) before it can be occupied.
requirements: Endorsement from the Office of the Building Official (OBO)
Certified true copy of the assessment fee for securing the Certificate of Occupancy, from OBO
Fire Safety Compliance and Commissioning Report (FSCCR), one (1) set, if necessary
fields.validity: Required once, as a prerequisite to occupancy; re-inspection may be required if occupancy or use later changes
fields.processNote: A statutory prerequisite to occupancy, issued after the FSEC and after construction is complete.
